question: Do Apayao State College or the University of Abra publicly expose the 2010 Apayao watershed maps/stations or the underlying Abra freshwater fish and mollusk reports?

publicResearchPages.observedScope: The official site navigation exposes completed-research lists for 2022 through 2025. The reviewed 2025 list includes later agri-fishery work, but not the exact 2010 mapping title.
The public local-journal page lists 2019, 2020 and 2021 issues; it did not expose the 2010 project report or AutoCAD map files.

The office page describes the institutional RDE remit and lists Dr. Maria Christina Z. Manicad as Director for Research & Special Projects, Luna Campus. It does not publish a direct email for this project request.

findings.boundedSearch: Exact-title and author-name searches on asc.edu.ph did not surface the underlying report, station table, maps, or an item-specific reuse statement. This is a screen of indexed public pages, not proof the institution does not hold the materials.
findings.contactRoute: Address an unsent request to the Office of the Vice President for Academics, Research & Development, and Extension Services / Research & Special Projects through an official ASC contact route. A project-specific direct email was not verified; do not substitute an unrelated recruitment address.

findings.institution: University of Abra (formerly Abra State Institute of Sciences and Technology)

publicResearchPages.observedScope: The official Research and Extension menu links to a Research Hub that presents an authentication screen; it does not expose the target report to an unauthenticated visitor.
The linked institutional journal host returned a gateway error in the reviewed web session, so its holdings could not be examined.

The current official directory lists Dr. Pablo B. Bose Jr., Director of Research, Development and Planning, and Dr. Mary Joan T. Guzman, author of the two Abra abstracts, with institutional email addresses. The directory identifies Dr. Guzman in a current quality-assurance role, not as the research director.

findings.boundedSearch: Exact-title/author searches on the indexed official domain did not surface the underlying freshwater reports or a species-by-station/voucher file. A login-only hub and a journal-host retrieval failure are access limits, not evidence of absence.
findings.contactRoute: The unsent draft is addressed to the current Research, Development and Planning Director and author using addresses published in the current official directory; verify recipients again immediately before sending.

apayao: Full report and version/date for Mapping of Potential Fish and Shell Production Areas in Apayao
The 18 station names and station-to-watershed/barangay crosswalk, coordinates and coordinate reference system
Original AutoCAD/GIS map files or a written statement that only rendered maps remain
Species-by-station list, survey dates and methods, identification references and voucher/accession numbers with custodian
Separate attribution, redistribution, public display and commercial-use terms for report text, maps, station data and taxa data
abra: Full reports and field dates for the freshwater fish/mollusk taxonomy and Lagayan/Lagangilang diversity studies
Reconciled scientific-name list and explanation of repeated genus/family labels in the abstract
Collection locality/tributary and station crosswalk, coordinates/CRS where held, sampling methods and identification references
Voucher/accession identifiers and present specimen custodian
Separate attribution, redistribution, public display and commercial-use terms for report, taxa table, coordinates and images

disposition.reason: Public institutional pages did not provide the underlying files or the rights needed to publish them. The next evidence-bearing action requires a reply or a newly accessible deposit.

nextAction: Use the unsent, institution-specific inquiry draft in national-car-apayao-abra-research-materials-request-draft-20261030.md if Joseph chooses to send it. Until a response or public deposit is verified, keep both projects as discovery leads and continue independent freshwater source discovery.
